newsitem.title: UK: MCCARTHY CORP BUYS STAKE IN BRANSON'S V-2 RECORDS.
newsitem.headline: MCCARTHY CORP BUYS STAKE IN BRANSON'S V-2 RECORDS.

text.p: McCarthy Corp Plc, the leisure and technology investment company, said on Sunday it had acquired a 33 percent stake in Richard Branson's V2 Records for 55 million pounds.

"Richard Branson's credentials in the music world are impeccable, and we are delighted to be able to participate in the development of what we are sure will become a highly successful international music and publishing business," McCarthy said in a news release.
It said consideration of 45 million pounds was payable in equal stages over 40 months.

McCarthy has also agreed to provide a debt facility of 10 million pounds to be available within two years of completion of the acquisition. It said 7.5 million pounds of financing has already been provided and further financing was expected pending completion.

V2 was Branson's vehicle to return to the music business following his sale of Virgin Records in 1992, McCarthy said. It is currently releasing its first product and plans eight significant album releases by the end of the year. Artists signed include Sterophonics, Heather Nova, Jungle Brothers and Addict.
